findings.claim: The gate's first-user-message extraction has two branches — array content (map(.text) | join) and plain-string content (. // "") — but test_skill_invoke_gate.sh builds every transcript with user_line, which always emits content as an array of text blocks. The string branch, which is the shape Claude Code records for a typed or claude -p prompt (see the string-content user line in cmd/tests/test_context_record.sh:25), is never exercised: rewriting line 29 to `else "" end` makes every string-content REQUIRE-SKILL session fail open (no marker found, exit 0) and the suite stays green.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh:27-32 (jq select of the first user line, if type == "array" ... else (. // "") end, then sed for REQUIRE-SKILL) and cmd/tests/test_skill_invoke_gate.sh:33 (user_line emits message.content as [{type:"text", text:$t}]) plus lines 40-44 and 92-93 — every transcript goes through user_line, none writes string content. cmd/tests/test_context_record.sh:25 shows the real transcript shape {"type":"user",...,"message":{"role":"user","content":"/concept do it"}} with string content. The claim holds: the string branch has no test.
findings.fix: Add a transcript built with jq -nc --arg t "$marker_txt" '{type:"user", message:{content:$t}}' and assert pre-invocation deny plus post-invocation silence, alongside test_pre_invocation_denied.

findings.claim: The diff makes sync_hooks.sh answer "n" on EOF (read -r answer || answer=n) so a non-interactive run (runSyncs in install_windows.go:386, the config server) with an installed hook that no longer exists in the repo keeps it instead of aborting under set -e. No test drives sync_hooks.sh at all (no cmd/tests file references it), so dropping `|| answer=n` again — which makes the script exit 1 at the prune prompt with stdin closed — keeps the suite green.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/sync/sync_hooks.sh:1-41: set -euo pipefail on line 2, the prune loop at 25-39 with read -r answer || answer=n on line 31. A grep of cmd/tests and internal/routines for sync_hooks returned no match; test_sync_skills_overrides.sh/test_sync_skills_variant.sh cover only sync_skills.sh. Without the guard, read hits EOF, returns 1 and set -e exits the script — the guarded behavior is unpinned.
findings.fix: Add cmd/tests/test_sync_hooks.sh: temp HOME, a stale ~/.claude/hooks/gone.sh, run sync_hooks.sh </dev/null, assert exit 0, 'kept:' in the output and gone.sh still present; a second run with printf 'y\n' asserts it is pruned.

findings.claim: Every test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh case runs with BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN=1, and the wrapper returns before routine_run_claude (line 128-131) and exits 0 before the postconditions (line 164-166). The wrapper-owned logic (header lines 4-8: the wrapper owns sequencing and the terminal state) — the token gate (exit 78, lines 45-52), the JSON-envelope logging to the results file, overall_status propagation (line 150/174), and the dirty-tree postcondition (exit 70, lines 167-171) — is never executed: inverting the line-167 check or dropping overall_status keeps the suite green. Spec-9 excludes only live claude execution, which a stub claude on PATH (the test_routine_worktree.sh pattern) avoids.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/bootstrap/run.sh:45-52 (token gate only when dry_run != 1), 118-152 (run_stage returns at 128-131 in dry-run), 157-174 (proposals file, dry-run exit 0 at 164-166, postconditions after) and cmd/tests/test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh:39-41 (run_wrapper always sets BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN=1) plus every case 43-107. Spec-9 Tests table row for test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh lists only dry-run cases and 'not tested: live claude stage execution'; test_routine_worktree.sh:68-75 shows the stub-claude harness. Distinct from the known roster (tests-NIT-13-r2) and overlay-overwrite (correctness-BLK-22-r1) rows.
findings.fix: Add a non-dry-run case with a stub claude on PATH that prints a JSON envelope and dirties the sandbox: assert exit 70 and a results-file line with stage/exit_status; a second stub exiting 3 on a clean tree asserts exit 3; a missing BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE asserts exit 78.
